_doc: Among Us chat lexicon for src/engine/chatNlu. All phrases are lower-case, apostrophes removed ('wasn't' -> 'wasnt'), single spaces. Multi-word phrases are matched longest-first (up to 4 words). Colours resolve to the player wearing that colour; rooms/tasks resolve against the current map (by room id OR room name), so per-map ids only need to agree with src/data/maps/<map>.json by id or name. Fuzzy matching (Damerau/OSA edit distance) applies only to colours, room aliases and long verbs: words of <= 4 letters must match exactly, 5-6 letters allow 1 edit, 7+ allow 2; anything in fuzzyBlock never fuzzy-matches.

rooms._note: Mira ids guessed; matched by name when the map file uses another id.
